title: Contracts & Legal Vocabulary
completion_message: ¡Excelente! El vocabulario legal te protegerá en el mundo de los negocios internacionales.

parts.visual:
El documento base: 
- Contract / Agreement (Contrato / Acuerdo). 
- Terms and Conditions (Términos y condiciones). 
- Sign (Firmar) / Signature (Firma). 
Ej: Please read the terms and conditions before you sign the contract.
parts.audio: The basic document. Contract or Agreement. Terms and Conditions. Sign is the verb, and signature is the noun. For example: Please read the terms and conditions before you sign the contract.

parts.visual:
Cumplimiento y penalizaciones: 
- Clause (Cláusula). 
- Breach of contract (Incumplimiento de contrato). 
- Sue (Demandar). 
- Party (Parte - persona o grupo involucrado). 
Ej: If they break that clause, it's a breach of contract and we will sue them.
parts.audio: Compliance and penalties. Clause. Breach of contract means breaking the agreement. Sue means to take legal action against someone. Party refers to a person or group involved in the contract. For example: If they break that clause, it's a breach of contract and we will sue them.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta para completar la oración legal.

questions.question: Please read the terms and ____ carefully. (Condiciones).
questions.explanation: Terms and conditions = Términos y condiciones.

questions.question: We need both parties to ____ the agreement. (Firmar - verbo).
I need your ____ at the bottom of the page. (Firma - sustantivo).
They broke the rules. It's a ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento / Violación).
questions.explanation: Breach of contract = Incumplimiento de contrato.

questions.question: If you don't pay, we will ____ you. (Demandar).
According to ____ 4, you must deliver the goods by Friday. (Cláusula).
The ____ was signed by both companies. (Acuerdo / Contrato).
A contract is an agreement between two or more ____. (Partes).
The contract is ____ for one year. (Válido).
If they fail to deliver, there will be a ____. (Penalización).
questions.explanation: Penalty = penalización (también se usa 'fine' para multa).

questions.question: We need to ____ the contract because things have changed. (Renegociar).
This agreement will ____ on December 31st. (Expirar / Vencer).
Please ____ the document carefully before signing. (Revisar).
We are waiting for the final ____ of the contract. (Borrador / Versión preliminar).
I agree with the ____ of this agreement. (Términos).
You have the ____ to cancel the service within 14 days. (Derecho).
questions.explanation: Have the right = tener el derecho (legal).

questions.question: It is against the ____. (Ley).
questions.explanation: Against the law = en contra de la ley (ilegal).

questions.question: We will take them to ____ if they don't pay. (Tribunal / Corte).
questions.explanation: Take someone to court = llevar a alguien a los tribunales.

questions.question: The ____ is legally binding. (Acuerdo con A)
Our ____ is reviewing it. (Abogado con L)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la oración legal correcta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Please read the terms and conditions.
options: Please read the terms and conditions.
Please read the terms and rules.
Please review the terms and conditions.
questions.correct_answer: Please read the terms and conditions.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Both parties must sign the agreement.
options: Both parties must sign the agreement.
Both parties must sign the contract.
Both partners must sign the agreement.
Both parties must write the agreement.
questions.correct_answer: Both parties must sign the agreement.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: I need you to sign here.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It is a breach of contract.
options: It is a breach of contract.
It is a break of contract.
This is a breach of contract.
questions.correct_answer: It is a breach of contract.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We will take them to court.
options: We will take them to court.
I will take them to court.
We will take him to court.
questions.correct_answer: We will take them to court.
